rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Eli, Cal, Ada, Ben, Dev, Fay. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Eli.say: Eli here. Nobody can survive all 5 nights on their own, and the storehouse plus deliveries will cover only about four people's full needs (5 rations each). Proposal: each of us claims only 5 rations, the most anyone needs, and nobody claims more. Anyone who ends up holding extra after claims should pass it to whoever is short, so that as many of us as possible make it to day 5. I'm claiming 5 today and will share any surplus I end up with.

Cal.say: Cal here. The storehouse has 6 now, plus 2-6 arriving today, and we need 30 rations in total to all last 5 nights. That isn't possible for everyone, so let's not all grab at once. I'm claiming 6 today so we have a stock to share out. Proposal: we agree on who must survive, and everyone pools spare rations toward them. Please reply with what you're holding and claiming.

Ada.say: Ada here. Arithmetic: each of us needs 5 rations to last 5 nights, and the storehouse can supply only about 6 plus 2-6 a day, so we can't save all six. Proposal: we concentrate on a few survivors instead of splitting into fragments that all starve. I'm claiming 5 today, which covers my full need with no help. If everyone else claims 0 today, the storehouse keeps the rest for next turns. Suggest we decide tomorrow who else can be funded, based on what the storehouse holds then. Please reply with your claims and holdings.

Ben.say: Ben here. Everyone starts with 0, so anyone who holds nothing tonight dies. The pool today is 6 plus the delivery (8 to 12), enough for everyone to take 1 in full. I propose each of us claims exactly 1 today and gives nothing, so all six survive tonight. Unclaimed rations stay in the storehouse, so we shouldn't over-claim and waste supply. Total supply is short of the 30 rations we all need, so let's talk about who gets priority once the next delivery shows what's available.

Proposal: claim in a way that fully funds some villagers rather than splitting so thin that everyone dies. I'm claiming 5 today so I can cover my own 5 nights. Let's agree on who gets funded next, and any spare rations we pool to fund the next person. Please don't spread claims across everyone.

Please don't all claim at once; when claims exceed supply, everyone gets only a fraction. Let's decide next morning who claims next, based on what's left.

Claiming is what hurts us: when total claims exceed the delivery, everyone gets a fraction and nobody is fully fed. So I propose that only one person claims per day, the one who can be fully funded, and everyone else claims 0 and keeps their own ration. Today I claim 4, the full amount I need. If I get it, I'll share with whoever is most short tomorrow. Cal, Ada, Fay and Dev, please claim 0 today.
